_comment: What each utility's own interconnection application asks for (review-audit draft 03), as cited DATA: loaded by backend/src/utilityRequirements.ts and read by the reviewer gate for the job's utility. Rows land SEEDED. A missing item is a warning unless the row quotes the utility's own page verbatim with a named source and the quote names the item (Helm's #637 bar); only then may whenMissing 'blocker' block. Records match the job's state and utility name (any of matchNames, as whole words, after lower-casing and '&' -> 'and'). A person's verified items or an official read on the utility's filing row (utility_filing_lookups.application_requirements_json) override these per key. To add a utility, add a record here: no code. Quotes were read from the page bytes on fetchedAt. Each item may carry `gates` (reviewer / qc; absent = both) and a `qc` block: how the QC baseline (baselineRules) reports it missing — items sharing a ruleId report as one result listing each item's label in {missing}; {utility} is the record's displayName. `strictDefault` is what QC checks for a utility with NO record (uncited, so it only warns and says the utility is not researched). `qcRuleDefinitions` is the QC rule catalogue for those rule ids (the rules table).
